title: Bleach
notes: Sludgy low-tuned guitars and visceral singing retain glimpses of sharp melodic writing.

title: Nevermind
notes: Loud-quiet shifts and irresistible choruses meet tight performances and carefully layered studio production.

title: In Utero
notes: Abrasive room sound offsets fragile melodies, with dry drums, feedback and strained vocals.

title: MTV Unplugged in New York
notes: Spare acoustic arrangements make original songs and selected covers sound exceptionally vulnerable.
